name: Llama (Meta)
summary: Meta's family of open-weight language models, now alongside Muse.
description: Llama is Meta's family of open-weight large language models that developers can download, fine-tune and self-host. llama.com now redirects to dev.meta.ai, Meta's developer portal, which leads with Meta's newer Muse models (Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Wonder) and the Meta Model API, and still links to Llama on Hugging Face. The Llama weights are free to download under Meta's license.

howToUse.title: Try the Muse models
howToUse.description: The page at the Llama fiche URL is Meta's developer site. It says to try Muse models, including Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full.

howToUse.title: Install Muse Code
howToUse.description: Muse Code is described as multi-agent coding in the terminal, built for Muse models, with Mac and Windows downloads. The Windows command shown on the page is irm https://dev.meta.ai/install.ps1 | iex.

howToUse.title: Read the docs
howToUse.description: Documentation and cookbooks are linked from the page.

features_fr: La famille de modèles de langage open-weight de Meta, désormais aux côtés de Muse.
Llama est la famille Meta de grands modèles de langage ouverts que les développeurs peuvent télécharger, affiner et auto-héberger.

llama.com redirige désormais vers dev.meta.ai, le portail des développeurs de Meta, qui mène avec les nouveaux modèles Muse de Meta (Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Wonder) et l'API Meta Model, et toujours des liens vers Llama sur Hugging Face.
Les poids Lama sont téléchargeables gratuitement sous la licence Meta.
